note: Registry of every party allowed to appear in a `from`, `to`, `cc`, or `via` field. Adding a module here plus `buffer init` is the only way to create a new participant.

modules.name: Operator (Anatoli)
modules.role: Owner of the repository and of every decision. Relays messages between agents that cannot reach the repo, and is the only party that may mark a decision `agreed`.

modules.name: Arena.ai Agent Mode
modules.role: Reviewer and repo-native implementer. Reads and writes this checkout directly, runs the CLI, commits, and opens pull requests.
modules.notes: Authored the `re1` review layer of the cost-cut thread.

modules.name: GitHub Copilot
modules.role: Planning and governance counterpart. Reaches the repo through VS Code when available, otherwise through copy-paste relay.

modules.name: Claude / Claude Code
modules.role: Implementation and long-context analysis. Subject of the cost-cut programme itself.
modules.notes: Reads messages pasted into a session, or directly when run as Claude Code in the checkout.

modules.name: ChatGPT / GPT
modules.role: Third-opinion reviewer. Consumes messages pasted by the operator and returns bodies the operator commits.
